description: This file contains functions and types for performing guarded HTTP requests within a Matrix SDK, including redirect handling, request building, and size-limited response reading.

methods.name: normalizeEndpoint
methods.description: Normalizes an endpoint string to ensure it starts with a slash.

methods.name: applyQuery
methods.description: Applies query parameters to a URL object.

methods.name: isRedirectStatus
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a redirect.

methods.name: toFetchUrl
methods.description: Converts a RequestInfo or URL to a string URL.

methods.name: buildBufferedResponse
methods.description: Creates a Response object with a given body and source response metadata.

methods.name: fetchWithMatrixGuardedRedirects
methods.description: Performs fetch with redirect handling, cross-protocol blocking, and dispatcher management.

methods.name: createMatrixGuardedFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that performs guarded requests with redirect and size limits.

methods.name: performMatrixRequest
methods.description: Performs a Matrix API request with size limits, redirect handling, and optional raw response.
